preconditions.description: Input must have exactly n cities, with valid capital indices r1 and r2 (distinct and within bounds).
The input must contain exactly n-1 parent indices (one for each non-capital city).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: Each parent index pi must be a valid city index (1 to n).

preconditions.expression: all(pi != i for i, pi in enumerate(p, start=2) if pi != r1)
preconditions.description: No city (other than the capital) can be its own parent in the old representation.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 parent indices (one for each non-new-capital city).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= new_pi <= n for new_pi in new_p)
postconditions.description: Each new parent index must be a valid city index (1 to n).

postconditions.expression: all(new_pi != i for i, new_pi in enumerate(new_p, start=2) if new_pi != r2)
postconditions.description: No city (other than the new capital) can be its own parent in the new representation.

postconditions.expression: all(any(ancestor == r2 for ancestor in path) for i in range(1, n + 1) if i != r2)
postconditions.description: For every city i ≠ r2, there must exist a path from r2 to i in the new tree (i.e., r2 is the new root).

postconditions.expression: all(new_p[i - 2] == parent_in_new_tree(i) for i in range(2, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The new parent array must correctly represent the tree structure with r2 as the new root, where parent_in_new_tree(i) is the parent of city i in the new tree.
